message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: arson causing property damage valued 17905 yuan. The defendant set fire to corn husks, corn cobs, then to clothes in wardrobe, causing fire in house, property damage. He acted out of emotion, not for profit. Likely crime: arson (故意毁坏财物罪? Actually Chinese criminal law: "放火罪" (Arson) under Article 114 of Criminal Law, if causing property damage, etc. Also possibly "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property) if fire not causing death. But arson is specific. Under Chinese law, "放火罪" is for setting fire to public or private property, causing serious consequences. The damage is 17905 yuan, which is "数额较大" (relatively large). So charge: "放火罪". Also maybe "非法占有他人财物罪"? No, no theft. So only arson.

Thus answer: [罪名]放火罪<eoa>
